newsitem.title: CANADA: Hollinger to raise Southam stake.
newsitem.headline: Hollinger to raise Southam stake.

text.p: Hollinger Inc said on Thursday it plans to make an offer through a wholly owned subsidiary on a pro rata basis for 7.0 million Southam Inc shares at C$18.75 per share.
If Hollinger acquires 7.0 million shares under the circular takeover offer, its stake in Southam will rise to 50.1 percent from 41 percent.
The offer is conditional upon at least 7.0 million shares being deposited under the offer and not withdrawn before its expiry date.
If more than 7.0 million shares are deposited under the offer, 7.0 million shares will be taken up and paid for proportionately according to the number of shares deposited by each shareholder.

But if more are deposited, Hollinger will have the right to take up more or all of the deposited shares as long as this number is more than 7.0 million or less than all of the deposited shares on a pro rata basis.
If less than 7.0 million shares are tendered, Hollinger has the right to take up all of the deposited shares.

Hollinger said it expects Southam to set up a special committee of directors independent of Hollinger to consider the bid and make a recommendation to the board. The offer is expected to be mailed to Southam holders by November 4.

Hollinger bumped its stake to 41 percent in May after buying Power Corp of Canada's 16.35 million Southam shares at C$18 a share. The C$18.75 price is based upon the amount paid to power "adjusted to reflect the time value of money," Hollinger said.
